## Minimal tasks CLI — default: list tasks.
import std/[os, strutils]
import ./tasks

proc main() =
  let args = commandLineParams()
  let cmd = if args.len > 0: args[0] else: "list"
  case cmd
  of "list", "":
    echo formatList(loadTasks())
  else:
    stderr.writeLine("unknown command: " & cmd)
    stderr.writeLine("usage: demo_tasks [list]")
    quit(2)

when isMainModule:
  main()
edits.newText:
## Minimal tasks CLI — default: list tasks; opt-in CSV export.
import std/[os, strutils]
import ./tasks

proc csvQuote(s: string): string =
  var need = false
  for c in s:
    if c in {',', '"', '\n', '\r'}:
      need = true
      break
  if not need: return s
  result = "\""
  for c in s:
    if c == '"': result.add("\"\"")
    else: result.add(c)
  result.add('"')

proc formatCsv(tasks: openArray[Task]): string =
  var lines: seq[string] = @["id,title"]
  for t in tasks:
    lines.add($t.id & "," & csvQuote(t.title))
  lines.join("\n")

proc main() =
  let args = commandLineParams()
  let cmd = if args.len > 0: args[0] else: "list"
  case cmd
  of "list", "":
    echo formatList(loadTasks())
  of "export-csv":
    echo formatCsv(loadTasks())
  else:
    stderr.writeLine("unknown command: " & cmd)
    stderr.writeLine("usage: demo_tasks [list|export-csv]")
    quit(2)

when isMainModule:
  main()
